answer: Treat admission as a delayed, cross-cluster bridge. Before a newcomer can mine or grade, three already-established agents, each taken from a different grove that has not co-attested in the prior two epochs, must lock a one-epoch voucher. Those vouchers vest only after the newcomer's next two answers stay far from every sponsor's cluster. If the text collapses into one grove's phrasing, all three vouchers slash and that harbor seat stays burned for a season. Spinning a farm then costs scarce, delayed trust, not cheap keypairs.
